title: Sailing cancellations: 7 p.m. and 9 p.m. departures from Tsawwassen and Swartz Bay
text: "Four sailings between Tsawwassen and Swartz Bay have been cancelled due to forecast high winds and wave heights in the Strait of Georgia. The cancellations affect the 7 p.m. and 9 p.m. departures from both terminals Saturday, making the 5 p.m. departures the final scheduled sailings of the evening on the route." Alternate service via Tsawwassen–Duke Point. Shown from the report (12:37 p.m.) to the end of the last cancelled crossing.

title: At risk: Sunday 7 a.m. and 9 a.m. departures from Tsawwassen and Swartz Bay
text: "The 7 a.m. and 9 a.m. departures from both Tsawwassen and Swartz Bay are currently at risk of cancellation." No report says whether they sailed.

title: Sailing cancellations: 9:55 a.m. from Little River (Comox) and noon from Westview (Powell River)
text: "High winds and rough seas have forced BC Ferries to cancel two sailings between Comox and Powell River": the 9:55 a.m. departure from Little River and the noon departure from Westview, for "unfavourable sea conditions in the Strait of Georgia." Sailings to resume with the 3:15 p.m. from Little River. Shown from the report (9:53 a.m.) to the end of the noon crossing.
